name: Premium Order Manager for WooCommerce
author: Hadi Shiri

sections.description:
Premium Order Manager for WooCommerce helps you manage your WooCommerce store more efficiently.

View customer & order stats, send bulk SMS/email campaigns using built‑in templates, import/export customer lists, convert guests to registered users, and manage user role capabilities – all from one dashboard.

Key Features

📊 Customer & Order Statistics
* View total orders, revenue, customer counts, and more
* Filter by date range for detailed insights

📧 Email Campaigns
* Send bulk emails to customers using built‑in templates
* Support for HTML and plain text formats
* Track open rates and click-throughs

📱 SMS Campaigns
* Send bulk SMS to customers via popular gateways (SMS.ir, Asanak)
* Customizable sender number
* Message archive for sent messages

📋 Import & Export
* Import customer lists via CSV
* Export customer data and order history
* Bulk update user roles

🔄 Guest to Registered User Conversion
* Convert guest customers to registered users with one click
* Preserve order history and metadata

👤 User Role Manager
* Manage WooCommerce capabilities per user role
* Fine‑tune permissions without writing code

Support and feedback

We’re committed to making this plugin better with each update. If you have ideas, questions, or run into any issues, please contact us at c.hadi.shiri@gmail.com.

Other plugins by Hadi Shiri

  • MasterAI Content Manager for WooCommerce – Generate WooCommerce product content using AI with support for multiple providers (Groq, Google Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and more).
  • Quick Price Editor for WooCommerce – Edit WooCommerce prices safely with filters, previews, and bulk adjustments.
  • Tinava Product Images for WooCommerce – Batch-resize, crop, and convert WooCommerce product images with preview, backup, and undo history.

Check out all our plugins on our WordPress.org profile.

External Services

This plugin connects to third‑party SMS gateway APIs to send SMS messages. The following external services are used:

SMS.ir (https://sms.ir)
* Used for: Sending SMS messages
* Data sent: Recipient phone number, message text, sender number
* When: When you manually send an SMS campaign or when automatic order notifications are triggered
* Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://sms.ir/terms-and-conditions/ (this page covers both terms and privacy)

Asanak (https://asanak.ir)
* Used for: Sending SMS messages
* Data sent: Recipient phone number, message text, sender number
* When: When you manually send an SMS campaign or when automatic order notifications are triggered
* Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://www.asanak.com/%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%DB%8C%D9%86-%D9%88-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA/ (this page covers both terms and privacy)

No other external services are used. The plugin does not send any data to external services unless you explicitly configure and use an SMS gateway.

Privacy Policy

Premium Order Manager for WooCommerce is committed to protecting your privacy.

Data Collection
* The plugin collects customer data (name, email, phone number, order history) that already exists in your WooCommerce store
* It does not collect any additional data beyond what is already stored in WooCommerce
* Configuration settings (SMS gateway credentials) are stored encrypted in your database

Data Sharing
* Customer data is only shared with SMS gateways when you explicitly send a campaign
* No data is shared with third‑party services for any other purpose
* You can delete customer data at any time through WordPress/WooCommerce

Your Control
* You can disable SMS/email features at any time
* All communications are user‑initiated and require explicit action by the store admin
* You can delete all plugin data by uninstalling the plugin

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact us at:
* Email: c.hadi.shiri@gmail.com
* WordPress Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/premium-order-manager-for-woocommerce/

sections.installation:
1. Upload the premium-order-manager-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooMaster → Premium Order Manager in the admin sidebar.
  4. Configure SMS gateway credentials in the Settings tab.
  5. Start managing customers and sending campaigns!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

How do I send an SMS campaign?

Go to WooMaster → Premium Order Manager → Campaign, select the SMS tab, choose recipients, write your message, and click Send SMS.

How do I configure SMS gateways?

Go to WooMaster → Premium Order Manager → Settings, select your gateway provider, and enter your API credentials.

Are my messages logged?

Yes, all sent SMS and emails are stored in the Message Archive.

Can I import customers from a CSV file?

Yes. Go to the Import/Export tab and upload your CSV file. The plugin will map columns to user fields.

Can I export orders?

Yes. You can export order data in CSV format for further analysis or integration with other tools.

What user roles can I manage?

You can manage capabilities for all existing user roles, including custom roles created by other plugins.
sections.changelog:
4.1.9

  • Renamed to “Premium Order Manager for WooCommerce” to comply with WordPress trademark policy
  • No functional changes

4.1.8

  • Fully refactored to remove all inline CSS/JS – now properly enqueued
  • Added prefix woomaster_ to all AJAX actions, options, and functions
  • Fixed register_setting sanitization (recursive)
  • Replaced anonymous callback for wp_mail_content_type with named method
  • Lowered menu position and integrated under WooMaster parent menu
  • Added complete external services documentation
  • Fixed all PHPCS and Plugin Check warnings

4.1.7

  • Improved security with nonce verification in all AJAX handlers
  • Enhanced UI responsiveness on mobile devices
  • Fixed compatibility with WordPress 6.7

4.1.6

  • Added support for Asanak SMS gateway
  • Improved template editor with real‑time preview
  • Bug fixes for CSV export encoding

4.1.0

  • Added user role capability manager
  • Enhanced import/export functionality with field mapping
  • Performance improvements for large customer databases

4.0.0

  • Complete rewrite with modern UI
  • Added campaign scheduling
  • Integrated statistics dashboard
  • Multi‑gateway SMS support
